products.name: SentinelOne Purple AI
products.note: Endpoint security AI; autonomous response; XDR platform; kill-switch capabilities

profile_text.body:
SentinelOne is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NYSE: S, CIK 0001583708) that describes itself as offering an AI-powered enterprise cybersecurity platform. The company's site presents its core offering as a unified platform covering endpoint, cloud, identity, and data protection, underpinned by what it calls a Security Data Lake. It positions the platform as designed to detect, contain, and respond to threats at machine speed, and states it can autonomously stop supply chain attacks, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse through a single lightweight agent.

SentinelOne's primary tracked AI product is Purple AI, categorized under Security and Identity AI. The company describes Purple AI as handling triage, correlation, and routine incident response through agentic workflows, with the stated aim of freeing analysts for higher-value decisions. The platform also incorporates what SentinelOne calls Autonomous Security Intelligence and includes extended detection and response (XDR) capabilities. The company notes it was recognized in the inaugural IDC MarketScape for SIEM, citing its AI-native approach to security data.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for SentinelOne at this time.
